messages:
jordan: Quick sync — finalizing internal announce copy for tomorrow's micro-release (model routing + small console perf fixes). Need one reviewer for comm tone and one ops signoff on rollback criteria.

maya: happy to review copy. sending a trimmed blurb now. :eyes:

maya: ```
Heads-up: we will release a small inference runtime update tomorrow 10:00 PT.
- Improvements: reduced cold-start latency for v2 models, small console rendering bug fix.
- Impact: brief routing cache warm-up (expected <5m), no data migration.
- Action: if you see increased 5xxs or token-timeouts, escalate to #eng-oncall and set rollout to 0%.
```

jordan: perfect. can you add a one-line SLA note? something like: "SLA unaffected; short warm-up may increase p95 for ~5 minutes."

maya: added. also included the pinned model versions and canary lanes.

eli: ops signoff: rollback criteria below look good but tweak threshold to >2% user-facing errors over 10m (not 5m). We want to avoid flipping for minor blips.

jordan: agreed. change to >2% errors sustained for 10m. canary cadence: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m checks.

maya: updated snippet: ```
Canary plan: 5% for 15min, monitor errors & latency. If >2% user-facing 5xx or token-timeout rate sustained for 10min, rollback to previous pinned model.
Pinned versions: model-a @v2.3.1, model-embed @v1.8.0
Rollback contact: @eli, @release-eng, #eng-oncall
```

release-eng: small ask — include the exact deploybot command we'll use in the announce so oncall can replay if needed.

jordan: good call. deploy command: ```sh
/deploy canary --service=runtime --image=runtime:20260310-7f3a --percent=5
```

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff scheduled by jordan at 2026-03-22T17:00:00Z. Dashboard: https://deploys.internal/release/1768501234

eli: one more ops note — set autoscale min nodes to current baseline +1 during rollout to avoid spiky autoscale triggers. I'll handle the infra switch 10min before start.

maya: copy wrapper for internal announce: "Tomorrow at 10:00 PT we will roll a small runtime update to improve cold-starts and fix console rendering. Expect a brief warm-up period; SLA unaffected. Oncall will monitor — see pinned channels for status."

jordan: final checklist: 
- [x] Copy reviewed (maya)
- [x] Ops thresholds agreed (eli)
- [x] Deploy command confirmed
- [ ] Post internal announce at 09:30 PT (jordan)

release-eng: I'll be on standby for rollback. tagging runbook: https://runbooks.internal/runtime-rollback

maya: can someone confirm we pin analytics so downstream dashboards don't alert on the warm-up?

eli: yes — I'll mute the synthetic alert rule for 30m starting at 09:55 PT.

jordan: ok launching dry-run of the deploy command in staging now (no traffic). will post short confirmation when done. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Staging deploy completed: runtime:20260310-7f3a (no errors).

jordan: thanks — final go to post announce at 09:30 PT unless anyone objects in next 30m.

maya: all good from comms. :+1:

eli: ops good.

release-eng: approved.

jordan: great — posting internal announce in 20.
